owner: existing Mac mini BACKEND single writer
goal: Implement the frozen intake-question lifecycle producer contract completely on the existing CORE branch, preserving the accepted CORS and N03 prerequisite commits.

worktree.rule: No reset, rebase, merge, branch switch, stash, clean or writer reassignment. Verify the frozen ownerBaseRule before the first write. Build gateway and request-handler changes on aa0bdb1 without reverting N03.

contract: The staged freeze JSON is exact and complete. Implement its contract, migrations, allowedWriterPaths, pathRestrictions, producerCutover and refusal table without aliases, placeholders or scope additions.
readOnly: all FRONTEND, DESIGN and synthetic client consumers
accepted CORS and N03 tests except as regression inputs
excluded: CCC-292, G7, S5/S6, Agent transport, provider egress, purge/restore
screens, CSS, shared UI, design artifacts, deployment, preview, credentials, AI/STT activation
new question table, duplicated question text, text/hash/order identity, compatibility alias, automatic legacy conversion or reopen behavior
implementationClarifications: The Database port accepts a prebound atomic batch and has no transaction callback. Preserve that port. After strict parsing, authorization, active-state checks and exact replay lookup, generate nonpersistent UUID candidates in memory, bind them into the one atomic batch, and persist them only when every CAS and guard succeeds. A failed batch leaves no ID, lifecycle, revision, outcome, audit or officialization row. Exact replay returns before candidate generation.
execution: Use the existing seams and the shortest complete implementation. No second canonical question store, no new endpoint, no new dependency.
Use LSP references before exported-symbol changes when a server is available. If unavailable, trace every caller and include the exact migration list in the result.
Develop against the frozen observable contract. Do not run project-wide suites, formatters or unrelated validation during implementation.

When the complete producer diff and semantic migration tests are ready, run exactly the writer-only parity update command from freeze.verification.commands. It must add the 0064/0020 checkpoint only after semantic proofs pass.
Record the resulting candidate commit and tree, complete changed path set, 0064/0020/parity SHA-256 values, parity-update output and any remaining unrun central checks.

Commit only explicit allowed paths locally. Do not bypass configured hooks. If hooks require an out-of-scope mutation, stop before commit and report. Do not push, merge, deploy or contact external services.

complete changed paths and file SHA-256 values
